lines.en: label yumicallnight35:
scene black
I tap on Yumi’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机里点了 Yumi 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: It’s something I never thought I’d be able to do.
lines.zh: 这是我从未想过自己能做的事。

lines.en: Of course, there’s no guarantee that she’ll answer.
lines.zh: 当然，她也不一定会接。

lines.en: The thought of calling her alone is just-
lines.zh: 光是想着要打电话给她这件事就——

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: Surreal?
lines.zh: 超现实？

lines.en: Like it’s the end of one age and the beginning of another.
lines.zh: 就像是一个时代的终结和另一个时代的开端。

lines.en: Then again, it’s probably just me being dramatic.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，大概只是我在小题大做。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Why are you calling me?
lines.zh: : 你打电话给我干嘛？

lines.en: : Why did you pick up?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么接了？

lines.en: : It’s dark out. I didn’t see the name on the ID thing.
lines.zh: : 外面黑。我没看见来电显示上的名字。

lines.en: : Does your phone not light up?
lines.zh: : 你手机不发光吗？

lines.en: : Shut up! It doesn’t matter why I fucking answered. What do you want?
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！我他妈为什么接的不重要。你想干嘛？

lines.en: : Just...wanted to see what you’re up to.
lines.zh: : 只是……想看看你在干嘛。

lines.en: : Well I’m walking. Is the call over now?
lines.zh: : 我在走路。可以挂了吗？

lines.en: : Walking where? It’s late.
lines.zh: : 走去哪儿？很晚了。

lines.en: : Chika’s place.
lines.zh: : Chika 家。

lines.en: : I’m sleeping there tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚睡那儿。

lines.en: : Cool. Maybe I’ll drop by as well.
lines.zh: : 不错。那我也许也顺道过去。

lines.en: : Fuck no you won’t. Chinami sleeps in a giant fuckin’ T-shirt and nothing else.
lines.zh: : 你去个屁。Chinami 睡觉就穿一件超大号 T 恤，别的什么都不穿。

lines.en: : If you think I’m letting you anywhere near her without pants on, you’re-
lines.zh: : 你要是以为我会让你不穿裤子靠近她，那你就——

lines.en: : See you soon, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 待会儿见，Yumi。

lines.en: : Wait!
lines.zh: : 等等！

lines.en: I go to hang up the phone as I’ve already decided what to do tonight, but an uncharacteristic, serious sort of urgency in Yumi’s voice beckons me to stop.
lines.zh: 我今晚已经打定主意要做什么，正要挂断电话，可 Yumi 声音里那种反常的、认真的急切让我停了下来。

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : How quickly can you get to the old district?
lines.zh: : 你多快能到老城区？

lines.en: : Are you...offering to hang out with me alone?
lines.zh: : 你这是……要约我单独见面？

lines.en: : If it keeps you away from Chinami, yeah. I can bite the bullet.
lines.zh: : 只要能让你离 Chinami 远点，对，我就认了。

lines.en: : You really have no faith in me at all, do you?
lines.zh: : 你是真的一点都不信我啊？

lines.en: : Why would I?
lines.zh: : 我凭什么信你？

lines.en: : Just...start heading over to Chika’s and I’ll meet you on the bridge or some shit.
lines.zh: : 你就……往 Chika 家那边走，我在桥上什么的等你。

lines.en: : They don’t know I’m on the way yet, so I don’t have like a time limit or anything.
lines.zh: : 她们还不知道我在路上，所以我没什么时间限制之类的。

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: The uncharacteristic urgency turns into an even less characteristic invitation.
lines.zh: 反常的急切变成了更反常的邀请。

lines.en: The only times I’ve ever really seen Yumi at night have been in her dorm room or...scattered occasions where she finds me wandering around the city.
lines.zh: 我真正见到 Yumi 的夜晚，基本只有她的宿舍，或者……她在城里撞见我游荡的零星几次。

lines.en: Is it safe for me to meet her tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚去见她安全吗？

lines.en: I don’t like the second half of town. I make that known rather frequently.
lines.zh: 我不喜欢镇子的另一半。这一点我表露得相当频繁。

lines.en: And with Yumi’s not-at-all suspicious tendency to be around for what she’s referred to as “mind comas or whatever-”
lines.zh: 再加上 Yumi 总会在我所谓的「精神昏迷还是什么」的时候出现在旁边，这一点完全不让人起疑——

lines.en: I worry for her.
lines.zh: 我为她担心。

lines.en: I should probably tell her that I don’t want-
lines.zh: 我大概该告诉她我不想——

lines.en: scene nightsky
: I’m on my way.
lines.zh: : 我这就过去。

lines.en: I lose control over my words and agree to doing something that could turn out simply horrible.
lines.zh: 我失去了对自己话语的控制，答应了一件可能会变得非常糟糕的事。

lines.en: My legs start moving on their own.
lines.zh: 我的腿开始自己动起来。

lines.en: I want to go back inside.
lines.zh: 我想回屋里去。

lines.en: It’s so cold.
lines.zh: 太冷了。

lines.en: : Whatever...
lines.zh: : 随便吧……

lines.en: : You have to cross the bridge to get to her house, so I’ll just wait for you over there.
lines.zh: : 去她家得过桥，那我就在那边等你。

lines.en: : {s}Be careful standing around that place at night.{/s} Sounds good. I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : {s}晚上在那儿站着小心点{/s}。听起来不错。待会儿见。

lines.en: : Yeah...bye.
Yumi hangs up before I have the chance to.
lines.zh: Yumi 先我一步挂了电话。

lines.en: Not like I’m sure if I’d be able to at this point anyway.
lines.zh: 反正我也不确定这会儿自己能不能挂得掉。

lines.en: Actually-
lines.zh: 其实——

lines.en: I feel fine now.
lines.zh: 我现在感觉好了。

lines.en: My legs stop moving on their own and I have to send signals to them via my brain to get them to move the old fashioned way instead.
lines.zh: 我的腿不再自己动弹，我得靠大脑给它们发信号，用最原始的方式让它们迈步。

lines.en: Walking is better when done manually.
lines.zh: 走路还是手动操作更好。

lines.en: I am excited to walk very far tonight.
lines.zh: 我很兴奋今晚要走很远的路。

lines.en: scene yumiknows1
I finish walking very far and end up in the second half of town, a foot or two in front of a girl I routinely [masturbate] to.
lines.zh: 我走完了很远的路，来到镇子的另一半，站在一个我常对着[masturbate]的女孩前一两英尺处。

lines.en: : Did you fucking run here or something? That was way quicker than I thought it would be.
lines.zh: : 你他妈是跑过来的还是怎么的？比我想的快太多了。

lines.en: : Sorry. I was just so excited to see you that I couldn’t contain myself.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是太想见你了，按捺不住。

lines.en: scene yumiknows2
: Give it a fucking rest. You were probably just doing laps around this place looking for me anyway.
lines.zh: : 少来这套。你大概本来就在这附近转圈找我呢。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t be the first time you’ve successfully hunted me down around here.
lines.zh: : 你在这附近成功逮到我，也不是第一次了。

lines.en: : Do you think anyone else would ever exert so much effort looking for you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得还有谁会为了找你费这么大劲？

lines.en: scene yumiknows3
: Probably fucking not, but you sound like even more of a dick than normal when you come out and say it like that.
lines.zh: : 大概他妈没有，但你这么直白说出来，比平时更像个混蛋。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. Just...feeling a little strange, I guess.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是……感觉有点奇怪吧。

lines.en: : What kind of strange? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 哪种奇怪？出什么事了？

lines.en: : Like I don’t even remember how I got here.
lines.zh: : 就像我根本不记得自己是怎么到这儿的。

lines.en: scene yumiknows4
: This shit again? Really?
lines.zh: : 又来这套？真的？

lines.en: : Either you’re lying about not being a fucking junkie or you need to go to a hospital, because this shit really {i}is{/i} getting out of hand.
lines.zh: : 要么你在撒谎说自己不是瘾君子，要么你得去医院了，因为这破事{i}实在是{/i}越来越离谱。

lines.en: : Let somebody else deal with this instead of me. I had plans tonight.
lines.zh: : 让别人去操心这事吧，别找我。我今晚有安排。

lines.en: : Plans you surrendered to spend time with me.
lines.zh: : 你为了陪我把安排都放弃了。

lines.en: scene yumiknows5
: Plans I {i}surrendered{/i} to prevent you from blacking out in front of anyone else.
lines.zh: : 我是为了不让你在别人面前昏过去才{i}放弃{/i}的。

lines.en: : Chika and Chinami adore you. You really wanna ruin that by coming all the way out here when you’re “not feeling well?”
lines.zh: : Chika 和 Chinami 都很喜欢你。你「身体不舒服」还大老远跑来，真要把这份喜欢毁掉吗？

lines.en: : {s}I don’t know what I want.{/s} What I want is you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : {s}我不知道自己想要什么{/s}。我想要的只有你，Yumi。

lines.en: What?
lines.zh: 什么？

lines.en: I didn’t-
lines.zh: 我不是——

lines.en: scene yumiknows6
: Watch your fucking mouth. It’s not funny to joke about shit like that.
lines.zh: : 管好你那张臭嘴。拿这种事开玩笑一点都不好笑。

lines.en: : {s}I’m sorry. I didn’t mean to.{/s} It’s not a joke. I genuinely-
lines.zh: : {s}对不起。我不是有意的。{/s}这不是玩笑。我是真的——

lines.en: scene yumiknows7
: If it’s not a fucking joke, it’s a trick! And I’m not gonna let you pull one over on me again!
lines.zh: : 如果不是玩笑，那就是圈套！我不会再让你耍我第二次！

lines.en: : I came out here to meet you tonight, didn’t I?!
lines.zh: : 我今晚可是出来见你了，不是吗？！

lines.en: : Either talk to me like a normal fucking human being or get lost! I don’t have time for this!
lines.zh: : 要么像个正常人一样跟我说话，要么滚蛋！我没时间陪你闹！

lines.en: scene smile
///////////////////////////////////humans tend to lose their way quite frequently, i find.
: Who are you?
lines.zh: : 你是谁？

lines.en: It becomes easier to speak all of a sudden.
lines.zh: 突然间说话变得容易了。

lines.en: I regain full control over my body and my tongue, but find myself surrounded by nothing but blackness.
lines.zh: 我重新掌控了自己的身体和舌头，却发现自己被纯粹的黑暗包围。

lines.en: I can feel hands on my shoulders.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到有手搭在我肩上。

lines.en: Or perhaps my hands on someone else’s.
lines.zh: 或者，是我的手搭在别人肩上。

lines.en: Whatever is happening, it’s not happening here.
lines.zh: 不管正在发生什么，都不是在这里发生的。

lines.en: : You don’t look very friendly.
lines.zh: : 你看起来不太友善。

lines.en: ///////////////////////////////////do not worry. it is only a temporary appearance.
///////////////////////////////////where is it you would like to go?
///////////////////////////////////i can take you anywhere you want.
///////////////////////////////////anywhere outside this half of town.
: What about Yumi?
lines.zh: : 那 Yumi 呢？

lines.en: : The girl I’m with.
lines.zh: : 和我在一起的那个女孩。

lines.en: : Outside of this abyss.
lines.zh: : 在这片深渊之外的那个。

lines.en: ///////////////////////////////////i know her by a different name.
: A different name?
lines.zh: : 另一个名字？

lines.en: ///////////////////////////////////it is a matter that does not concern you.
///////////////////////////////////but, if it will make you happy, i can send you back to her.
///////////////////////////////////is that where you would like to go?
: I don’t know. Does she look mad?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。她看起来生气吗？

lines.en: ///////////////////////////////////but she always looks scared when she is with you.
///////////////////////////////////the same way you always looked scared when you were with her.
: With who?
lines.zh: : 和谁在一起？

lines.en: scene yumiknows8
I find myself leaned up against the same guardrail where Yumi and I first kissed.
lines.zh: 我发现自己靠在同一段护栏上——那正是我和 Yumi 初吻的地方。

lines.en: She doesn’t look mad at all, thankfully.
lines.zh: 幸好她看上去一点也不生气。

lines.en: If I were in her shoes, and someone went and did something as inconvenient as getting sucked into what I can only vaguely recall as an abyss-
lines.zh: 如果我是她，有人干出被吸进一片我只能模糊记起的深渊这种麻烦事——

lines.en: Well, I don’t think I’d be very happy.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想我不会太高兴。

lines.en: Especially when she should be somewhere else right now.
lines.zh: 更何况她现在本该在别的地方。

lines.en: : You should really be fuckin’ paying me for this shit, you know?
lines.zh: : 你真该为这种事付我钱，知道吗？

lines.en: : I’m surprised you didn’t just leave me down there.
lines.zh: : 我很意外你没把我一个人丢在那儿。

lines.en: I obviously can’t see what Yumi sees, but I imagine that the two of us have our sights set on the bridge we started on tonight.
lines.zh: 我当然看不见 Yumi 在看什么，但我想我们俩此刻的目光都落在今晚出发的那座桥上。

lines.en: How...or rather, {i}why{/i} we ended up here is an entirely different question, though.
lines.zh: 至于我们是怎么……或者说{i}为什么{/i}会到这儿来，那就是另一个问题了。

lines.en: : I wanted to. But you looked so fuckin’ helpless that I just...
lines.zh: : 我本来想那么做。可你看起来太无助了，我就……

lines.en: : Kinda grabbed you and brought you up here to relax.
lines.zh: : 就抓着你，把你带到这儿来缓缓。

lines.en: : Did we hold hands?
lines.zh: : 我们牵手了吗？

lines.en: scene yumiknows9
: I mean...kind of! But only because I had to!
lines.zh: : 我是说……算是吧！但我是没办法！

lines.en: : You’re too big to fucking carry!
lines.zh: : 你太大只了，我他妈抱不动！

lines.en: scene yumiknows10
: And...I’m wearing gloves anyway. So it was kind of like it never even happened.
lines.zh: : 而且……我还戴着手套。所以基本上就等于没发生过。

lines.en: : In fact, it never {i}did{/i} happen.
lines.zh: : 事实上，它{i}就是{/i}没发生过。

lines.en: : We both walked up here alone and, now that you’re fuckin’ normal again, it’s time to split up.
lines.zh: : 我们俩是自己各自走上来的，既然你现在又正常了，那就该分开走了。

lines.en: : But why {i}here{/i} of all places?
lines.zh: : 可为什么偏偏是{i}这儿{/i}？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : I kind of like the view from up here.
lines.zh: : 我有点喜欢从这儿看出去的风景。

lines.en: : Sucks you had to go and scar me so I can barely come up to fucking see it anymore.
lines.zh: : 可惜你非得给我留下心理阴影，搞得我现在几乎不敢上来看了。

lines.en: I take a step back as she says this, putting a fair amount of distance between us so if I {i}do{/i} happen to snap again, she’ll be able to get away.
lines.zh: 她这么说的时候我后退了一步，在两人之间留出相当的距离，这样万一我再次{i}失控{/i}，她也能逃开。

lines.en: Or at least hurl herself over the guardrail like Shel Silverstein would have wanted.
lines.zh: 或者至少像 Shel Silverstein 所期望的那样，翻过护栏跳下去。

lines.en: scene yumiknows11
: Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : Please don’t feel the need to thank me for backing up.
lines.zh: : 别觉得有必要为我后退而道谢。

lines.en: : Why? It’s one of the few times you’ve actually done something to make me {i}more{/i} comfortable instead of fucking with me like you normally do.
lines.zh: : 为什么？这是你为数不多真的做了件让我{i}舒服{/i}的事，而不是像平时那样耍我。

lines.en: : Because the only reason you’re {i}uncomfortable{/i} is because of me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 因为让你{i}不舒服{/i}的根源本来就是我。

lines.en: scene yumiknows12
: I’m always uncomfortable around here.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿总是不自在。

lines.en: : Especially at night.
lines.zh: : 尤其是晚上。

lines.en: : All those fuckin’ homeless people. You know?
lines.zh: : 全是些该死的流浪汉。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Are they like...violent or something?
lines.zh: : 他们是……会动手还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I haven’t really encountered any issue like that around here.
lines.zh: : 我在这附近倒没真遇上过这种事。

lines.en: : Not violent. Just fucking weird.
lines.zh: : 不是暴力。就是他妈的怪。

lines.en: : Like they’ve had all the life sucked out of them or some shit. And now they just line the streets without anywhere to be or anything to do.
lines.zh: : 就像是精气神全被人抽干了什么的。现在他们就那么沿街排着，无处可去，无事可做。

lines.en: : You think I’ll end up like that one day?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我有一天也会变成那样吗？

lines.en: : Do {i}you{/i}?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}觉得呢？

lines.en: : Beats me. Not like I have anything goin’ for me.
lines.zh: : 谁知道。反正我也没什么拿得出手的东西。

lines.en: : Fail at shit all the time. Succeed at shit never.
lines.zh: : 什么事都搞砸，什么事都成不了。

lines.en: : It’s kind of like I’m stuck in some sorta abyss or some shit. Know what I mean?
lines.zh: : 就有点像我被困在什么深渊里之类的。懂我意思吗？

lines.en: : More than you could imagine.
lines.zh: : 比你想象的更懂。

lines.en: : Yeah?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Guess the difference is that I stay conscious when I feel like that and you turn into a fucking zombie.
lines.zh: : 大概区别就在于，我那样的时候还清醒着，而你直接变成了丧尸。

lines.en: : Well thank you for always dealing with it.
lines.zh: : 那就谢谢你每次都陪我熬过来。

lines.en: : Long as you don’t lay your hands on me, it’s whatever.
lines.zh: : 只要你不碰我，别的都无所谓。

lines.en: : Speaking of which-
lines.zh: : 说到这个——

lines.en: : When I was...out of it, I felt someone’s hands on my shoulders.
lines.zh: : 我……失去意识的时候，感觉到有人的手搭在我肩上。

lines.en: : Was that you?
lines.zh: : 是你吗？

lines.en: scene yumiknows13
: Huh? No. All I did was just kind of drag you along by your wrist.
lines.zh: : 啊？不是。我只是拽着你的手腕把你拖上来而已。

lines.en: : Maybe it was one of the homeless people? Sly fuckers, some of them.
lines.zh: : 也许是哪个流浪汉？他们里有些人挺贼的。

lines.en: : Huh...
: Could have just been hallucinating it.
lines.zh: : 也可能只是我产生了幻觉。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : So, what now? It’s already really dark. Aren’t Chika and Chinami expecting you?
lines.zh: : 那么，现在怎么办？天已经很黑了。Chika 和 Chinami 不是在等你吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll head over there in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我过几分钟就过去。

lines.en: : Just tryin’ to be nice for once and make sure you can find your way back and shit.
lines.zh: : 只是难得想做回好人，确认你能找着路回去什么的。

lines.en: : You’re being suspiciously nice tonight.
lines.zh: : 你今晚好得有点可疑。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: scene yumiknows14
The moonlight reflects off of Yumi’s pale skin as she gazes up at the sky.
lines.zh: 月光映在 Yumi 苍白的皮肤上，她抬眼望着天空。

lines.en: When you factor in her clothing and how it completely contrasts with the world around her right now, it makes it seem like she’s not supposed to be here at all.
lines.zh: 再加上她的衣着与此刻周遭的世界形成完全的对比，让人觉得她根本就不属于这里。

lines.en: But perhaps none of us are supposed to be here?
lines.zh: 但也许，我们谁都不属于这里？

lines.en: Perhaps, and this is just one more guess to throw into the pile of “things I can’t explain-”
lines.zh: 也许——这只是往「我解释不了的事」那堆里再添一个猜测——

lines.en: But perhaps the only reason I so frequently “black out” beside her is that neither of us belong here.
lines.zh: 也许我之所以总在她身边「断片」，是因为我们俩都不属于这里。

lines.en: {i}Here{/i} as in together.
lines.zh: {i}这里{/i}，指的是彼此在一起。

lines.en: We’re two people with nothing in common who keep getting tossed into situations that wind up making one of us uncomfortable or out-of-place.
lines.zh: 我们两个毫无共同点的人，总是被扔进同一种处境，最后总要有一个人感到不适或格格不入。

lines.en: More common than not, that person is her.
lines.zh: 那个人多半是她。

lines.en: Tonight is different, though.
lines.zh: 不过今晚不一样。

lines.en: Tonight, I will feel out of place no matter who I’m with or where I am.
lines.zh: 今晚，不管我和谁在一起、身在何处，我都会觉得格格不入。

lines.en: There is no place for me here.
lines.zh: 这里没有我的位置。

lines.en: This is not my world.
lines.zh: 这不是我的世界。

lines.en: if chikaonsen4 == False:
: Fuck. This is harder to say than I thought it would be.
lines.zh: : 操。这比我以为的难说多了。

lines.en: scene yumiknows15
: I don’t...{i}hate{/i} you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不……{i}恨{/i}你，老师。

lines.en: : Like, I still think you’re a fucking scumbag and want to vomit every time I come up here.
lines.zh: : 就是，我仍然觉得你是个混账，而且每次走到这儿都想吐。

lines.en: : But I don’t hate you.
lines.zh: : 但我不恨你。

lines.en: : And also, I’m kind of a scumbag too. So I get it.
lines.zh: : 还有，我自己也挺混账的。所以我懂。

lines.en: : We’re two shitty people. Just I pick on the ones I don’t like and you try to get into their pants.
lines.zh: : 我们都是烂人。区别只是我专挑自己讨厌的人欺负，而你总想钻进她们的裤裆里。

lines.en: : Trying to get into girls’ pants doesn’t make me a scumbag.
lines.zh: : 想钻女孩子的裤裆并不代表我是混账。

lines.en: : If it’s the entire fucking class, then yeah. It does.
lines.zh: : 如果对象是全班的话，那就是。没错。

lines.en: : So if it was only {i}you{/i}, it would be okay?
lines.zh: : 那如果只有{i}你{/i}一个，就没问题了？

lines.en: scene yumiknows16
: Ew, no! That wouldn’t be okay at all!
lines.zh: : 呕，不！那更不行！

lines.en: : But at least I’d be able to find some respect for you if you’d just fucking pick one and stick with her.
lines.zh: : 但至少你能不能他妈挑定一个就跟她好好过，那样我还能对你有点尊重。

lines.en: scene yumiknows17
: Like...I don’t know. Chika?
lines.zh: : 比如……我不知道。Chika？

lines.en: : Are you...giving me your blessing right now?
lines.zh: : 你这是……在给我祝福？

lines.en: : I’m not giving you shit.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没给你。

lines.en: : It just...kinda hurts watching her fall so hard for you when I know the type of guy you really are and she doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 只是……看着她为你陷得那么深，而我清楚你到底是什么货色、她却不知道，这让我有点难受。

lines.en: : I’m tired of hearing how excited she is to go on that fucking trip with you and I’m tired of how many times I have to tell her “Maybe tomorrow.”
lines.zh: : 我听腻了她有多期待跟你去那趟该死的旅行，也腻了一次又一次得对她说「也许明天吧」。

lines.en: : Might be hard to believe since it’s me and shit, but I care about her a lot.
lines.zh: : 虽然是我这种人说的，可能很难信，但我真的很在乎她。

lines.en: : Her and Chinami are all I have now.
lines.zh: : 她和 Chinami 是我现在仅有的一切了。

lines.en: scene yumiknows18
: Which is why I’m not going to let you trample all over her naive fucking heart.
lines.zh: : 所以我不会让你把她那颗天真的心踩烂。

lines.en: : Put her first.
lines.zh: : 把她放在第一位。

lines.en: : Tell her everything she wants to hear and never even {i}think{/i} about screwing her over. Got it?
lines.zh: : 她想听什么你就说什么，永远别{i}想着{/i}玩弄她。明白吗？

lines.en: : {i}Got it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}明白吗？{/i}

lines.en: : I appreciate your resolve-
lines.zh: : 我很欣赏你的决心——

lines.en: : But you should keep your nose out of my love life.
lines.zh: : 但你少管我的感情生活。

lines.en: : I’m not going to just drop everything and be with one person because you told me to.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为你一句话就放弃一切，只跟一个人在一起。

lines.en: : Chika is a great girl, don’t get me wrong.
lines.zh: : Chika 是个好女孩，别误会。

lines.en: : But she’s almost {i}too{/i} great.
lines.zh: : 但她好得几乎{i}过头{/i}了。

lines.en: : Like, she shouldn’t be with me.
lines.zh: : 就像，她不该跟我在一起。

lines.en: scene yumiknows19
: Well you’re definitely right about that.
lines.zh: : 这点你确实说对了。

lines.en: : Who the fuck {i}would{/i} be good with you, then?
lines.zh: : 那他妈谁{i}适合{/i}跟你在一起？

lines.en: : Would have to be a real screw up. Equally as douchey. Zero work ethic. A whole bunch of shit.
lines.zh: : 那得是个彻底的失败者。一样混账。一点上进心都没有。反正一堆破毛病。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like we might be a better match than you think.
lines.zh: : 听起来我们可能比你以为的更般配。

lines.en: scene yumiknows20
: Wha-?! Shut the fuck up! We would not!
lines.zh: : 什——？！他妈闭嘴！我们才不是！

lines.en: : Yumi Yamaguchi...
lines.zh: : Yumi Yamaguchi……

lines.en: : Will you marry me?
lines.zh: : 你愿意嫁给我吗？

lines.en: : That’s it! I’m leaving!
lines.zh: : 够了！我走了！

lines.en: : Never call me again!
lines.zh: : 别再给我打电话！

lines.en: scene black
Yumi runs off into the night and I’m unable to keep up with her.
lines.zh: Yumi 跑进了夜色里，我追不上她。

lines.en: I could just go back to Chika’s place to see her again but...
lines.zh: 我大可以回 Chika 家再见她一面，不过……

lines.en: I feel like I should probably let her sit on my totally serious marriage proposal for a little longer before following up.
lines.zh: 我觉得大概该让她多消化一会儿我那百分百认真的求婚，别急着追问。

lines.en: I obviously know Chika likes me.
lines.zh: 我当然知道 Chika 喜欢我。

lines.en: And I’m glad that Yumi is finally able to talk about that with at least some semblance of seriousness to it.
lines.zh: 我也很高兴 Yumi 终于能带着哪怕一丝认真的态度谈论这件事。

lines.en: But I do think it would be good if she’d think of herself more instead.
lines.zh: 但我确实觉得，她要是能多为自己着想一点会更好。

lines.en: Because, despite the constant beratement-
lines.zh: 因为，尽管她一直在骂我——

lines.en: It’s as clear as the sky in the second half of town...
lines.zh: 就像镇子另一半的天空一样明朗……

lines.en: That she may be starting to feel something as well.
lines.zh: 她自己或许也开始对我有感觉了。

$ yumicallnight35 = True
{i}Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]！{/i}

else:
: I heard about what happened with you and Chika.
lines.zh: : 你和 Chika 的事我听说了。

lines.en: Well, that secret didn’t last very long.
lines.zh: 嗯，这个秘密没保住多久。

lines.en: : I don’t know how much of it is just fucking manipulation on your part, but I’m trying to give you the benefit of the doubt.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这其中有多少钱是你他妈的操纵，但我在试着先信你一回。

lines.en: : So when you say shit like “I want you, Yumi...” it really pisses me the fuck off.
lines.zh: : 所以当你说出「我想要你，Yumi……」这种话，我真他妈气炸了。

lines.en: scene yumiknows18
: Chika is a good fucking person. And, for whatever reason, she wants {i}you{/i} instead of anyone else.
lines.zh: : Chika 是个他妈的好人。而且不知道为什么，她偏偏就想要{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Being her boyfriend or whatever is a good start since...I know you haven’t done anything else with her yet-
lines.zh: : 当她男朋友什么的算是个不错的开始，毕竟……我知道你还没对她做别的事——

lines.en: Oh...so the sex part is still a secret?
lines.zh: 哦……所以上床那部分还是秘密？

lines.en: I’m honestly surprised Chika managed to hold back that much.
lines.zh: 说实话，我很意外 Chika 居然忍得住没说。

lines.en: That’s...actually really cool of her.
lines.zh: 这……其实她挺了不起的。

lines.en: : But the second I find out you’re doing something to hurt her, I will destroy you.
lines.zh: : 但只要我发现你做了什么伤害她的事，我会毁了你。

lines.en: : So even if you’re joking when you say all that pervy shit to me, know that you’d be hurting the sweetest, most faithful girl I’ve ever met a lot if she ever heard any of it.
lines.zh: : 所以就算你跟我说那些下流话是在开玩笑，你也该知道，万一她听见了，你会深深伤害我见过最温柔、最专一的女孩。

lines.en: : And she told you that this was something that shouldn’t be discussed with anyone else, right?
lines.zh: : 她应该告诉过你，这件事不该跟别人说吧？

lines.en: scene yumiknows21
: She did.
lines.zh: : 她说了。

lines.en: : But I think that’s less about wanting to keep it a secret and more about you still wanting to fuck around with other girls.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得，与其说是想保密，不如说是因为你还想跟别的女孩乱搞。

lines.en: : If you were willing to go after me of all people, I can only imagine what kind of shit you’ve tried doing to some of the others.
lines.zh: : 连我这样的人你都敢下手，我能想象你对其他人干过些什么。

lines.en: : Like I said, I’m going to try to give you the benefit of the doubt for her sake.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，看在她的份上，我试着先信你。

lines.en: : But I’ll be fucking watching you. Got it?
lines.zh: : 但我会他妈盯着你。明白吗？

lines.en: : And the second you do anything that might hurt her, I’m not only telling her about it, but I’m going to ruin your fucking life.
lines.zh: : 只要你做出任何可能伤害她的事，我不光会告诉她，还要毁了你的人生。

lines.en: : I don’t care if the principal won’t believe me. I’m telling him. I’m telling that fucking weird, purple haired goth teacher too.
lines.zh: : 就算校长不信我也无所谓。我会告诉他。我也会告诉那个古怪的紫头发哥特老师。

lines.en: : Shit, I’ll send a letter to the fucking newspaper.
lines.zh: : 操，我还会给报社写信。

lines.en: scene yumiknows22
: I...will not...let you hurt that girl.
lines.zh: : 我……不会……让你伤害那个女孩。

lines.en: : You’re being surprisingly mature about this.
lines.zh: : 你在这件事上成熟得出人意料。

lines.en: : So?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？

lines.en: : I just kind of expected more of a freak out...You know, maybe a few more insults and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为你会炸得更厉害一点……你知道，多骂我几句什么的。

lines.en: : I’m too tired to insult you.
lines.zh: : 我懒得骂你了。

lines.en: : I just want to go eat ice cream at Chika’s house.
lines.zh: : 我只想去 Chika 家吃冰淇淋。

lines.en: : What is it with you and ice cream all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然这么执着于冰淇淋？

lines.en: scene yumiknows20
: It’s not “all of a sudden!” It’s fucking ice cream, dude! I have liked it forever!
lines.zh: : 才不是「突然」！那是他妈的冰淇淋啊，老兄！我一直都喜欢！

lines.en: : You certainly seemed to enjoy it with the way you-
lines.zh: : 你看上去确实很享受，看你那——

lines.en: : That’s it! Conversation is over!
lines.zh: : 够了！谈话结束！

lines.en: : Enjoy your walk back home, asshole!
lines.zh: : 好好享受你走回去的路吧，混蛋！

lines.en: scene black
: Wait, Yumi. I-
lines.zh: : 等等，Yumi。我——

lines.en: : I said the conversation is over! Stop following me!
lines.zh: : 我说了谈话结束！别跟着我！

lines.en: Yumi runs off into the night and I’m unable to keep up with her.
lines.zh: Yumi 跑进了夜色里，我追不上她。

lines.en: I could just go back to Chika’s place to see her again but...
lines.zh: 我大可以回 Chika 家再见她一面，不过……

lines.en: Given everything we talked about tonight, it’s probably best if I just leave things alone for now.
lines.zh: 考虑到今晚我们谈了这么多，眼下大概最好还是别再招惹她。

lines.en: I’m not sure what knowing about Chika and me will do to my relationship with Yumi-
lines.zh: 我不知道她知道我和 Chika 的事之后，会对我和 Yumi 的关系造成什么影响——

lines.en: But at least I can find some form of solace in knowing that she’s a good person deep down.
lines.zh: 但至少，知道她骨子里是个好人，能让我得到某种宽慰。

lines.en: I doubt that about her sometimes.
lines.zh: 这一点我有时也会怀疑。

lines.en: I probably shouldn’t, though.
lines.zh: 不过我大概不该怀疑。

lines.en: Not when I’m ten times worse.
lines.zh: 毕竟我比她烂十倍。
